scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns all equivalence relations on the rational dense order invariant under a fixed finite pointwise stabilizer; no unordered atom groups, arbitrary binary relations or uniform measure over unbounded support sizes are covered. Existing OEIS A208782 already contains the numeric sequence; the claimed contribution is the order-symmetry equivalence classification and essential-support law. The proof invokes established least-support and Bell-ratio theorems. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Gap-collapse classification and essential-support census for ordered atoms
